name: BudgetPositionProjection
description: Deterministic exact plan-versus-current-actual result shared by owner reads and the INSIGHTS read contract.
schema_def: - calculationSchemaVersion: `budget-position-v2` (was `budget-position-v1`; ancestor row totals change meaning under unchanged field names, so consumers branch on this token)
- directActualMinorUnits: Int64 — Budget Actuals whose exact assigned Spend Category equals this row category
- descendantActualMinorUnits: Int64 — Budget Actuals absorbed from descendant Spend Categories carrying no nearer Category Budget Entry
- absorbedCategoryIds: string[]? — the absorbed descendant Spend Category identifiers, ascending ordinal order, null or empty when nothing was absorbed
- Invariant: actual equals directActualMinorUnits plus descendantActualMinorUnits exactly. The partition reports the composition of the row total and is never additive on top of it.
- Unbudgeted rows never absorb: direct actual equals the row actual, descendant actual is exactly zero, absorbed identifiers empty. Only rows produced by a Category Budget Entry absorb descendants.

UncategorizedPosition kind Uncategorized with categoryId/name absent, actual present, planned/remaining/over null, direct actual equal to the row actual, descendant actual zero, absorbed identifiers empty.

Totals contain exact planned, actual, remaining, over and exact bucket subtotals. Planned equals explicit entry sum; actual equals Budgeted + ZeroBudget + Unbudgeted + Uncategorized. Negative actuals remain signed. No pace, forecast, trend, anomaly, recommendation, narrative, alert, control decision, or report-snapshot field.
BudgetActualMember (shared with the INSIGHTS read contract; carries per-Budget-Actual envelope provenance)
- categoryId: string? — exact assigned Spend Category, null when Uncategorized Spend
- ancestryIds: string[] — frozen Spend Category ancestry from LEDGER ActualsPageItem.FrozenAncestryIds, root-first with the assigned Spend Category as the final element; empty when categoryId is null
- effectiveCategoryId: string? — the Spend Category whose Category Budget Entry governed this Budget Actual, or null when the outcome is Unbudgeted Spend or Uncategorized Spend

Envelope resolution over ancestryIds is specified by DD-BUDGET-CATEGORY-ENVELOPE-RESOLUTION: scan from the final index toward index zero and take the first element carrying a Category Budget Entry. Ancestry validation mirrors the LEDGER ActualsCalculator invariant — non-empty and final element equal to categoryId when categorized, empty when uncategorized, distinct elements, every element present in the known Spend Category evidence set — and any violation returns the stable integrity failure with no partial result.
